The only page that names a 1kWh station with 1,000W over two inputs is Volt & Valley, a niche affiliate guide quoting published specs with no testing. Jackery's spec sheets cover single products at 800W or less, the rest are brand pages, a panel maker's wholesale guide and four empty results. A focused comparison with current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
